record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Blessed<WH0835> <FI>is<Fi> he that considereth<WH07919><WTH8688> the poor<WH01800>: the LORD<WH03068> will deliver<WH04422><WTH8762> him in time<WH03117> of trouble<WH07451>. <RF>the poor: or, the weak, or, sick<Rf> <RF>in time...: Heb. in the day of evil<Rf>

The LORD<WH03068> will preserve<WH08104><WTH8799> him, and keep him alive<WH02421><WTH8762>; <FI>and<Fi> he shall be blessed<WH0833><WTH8795> upon the earth<WH0776>: and thou wilt not deliver<WH05414><WTH8799> him unto the will<WH05315> of his enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>. <RF>thou...: or, do not thou deliver<Rf>

The LORD<WH03068> will strengthen<WH05582><WTH8799> him upon the bed<WH06210> of languishing<WH01741>: thou wilt make<WH02015><WTH8804> all his bed<WH04904> in his sickness<WH02483>. <RF>make: Heb. turn<Rf>
I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, LORD<WH03068>, be merciful<WH02603><WTH8798> unto me: heal<WH07495><WTH8798> my soul<WH05315>; for I have sinned<WH02398><WTH8804> against thee.<CM>
Mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> speak<WH0559><WTH8799> evil<WH07451> of me, When shall he die<WH04191><WTH8799>, and his name<WH08034> perish<WH06><WTH8804>?

And if he come<WH0935><WTH8804> to see<WH07200><WTH8800> <FI>me<Fi> , he speaketh<WH01696><WTH8762> vanity<WH07723>: his heart<WH03820> gathereth<WH06908><WTH8799> iniquity<WH0205> to itself; <FI>when<Fi> he goeth<WH03318><WTH8799> abroad<WH02351>, he telleth<WH01696><WTH8762> <FI>it<Fi> .
All that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> me whisper<WH03907><WTH8691> together<WH03162> against me: against me do they devise<WH02803><WTH8799> my hurt<WH07451>. <RF>my...: Heb. evil to me<Rf>

An evil<WH01100> disease<WH01697>, <FI>say they<Fi> , cleaveth fast<WH03332><WTH8803> unto him: and <FI>now<Fi> that he lieth<WH07901><WTH8804> he shall rise up<WH06965><WTH8800> no more<WH03254><WTH8686>. <RF>An...: Heb. A thing of Belial<Rf>

Yea, mine own familiar<WH07965> friend<WH0376>, in whom I trusted<WH0982><WTH8804>, which did eat<WH0398><WTH8802> of my bread<WH03899>, hath lifted up<WH01431><WTH8689> <FI>his<Fi> heel<WH06119> against me. <RF>mine...: Heb. the man of my peace<Rf> <RF>lifted...: Heb. magnified<Rf>
But thou, O LORD<WH03068>, be merciful<WH02603><WTH8798> unto me, and raise me up<WH06965><WTH8685>, that I may requite<WH07999><WTH8762> them.
By this I know<WH03045><WTH8804> that thou favourest<WH02654><WTH8804> me, because mine enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> doth not triumph<WH07321><WTH8686> over me.
And as for me, thou upholdest<WH08551><WTH8804> me in mine integrity<WH08537>, and settest<WH05324><WTH8686> me before thy face<WH06440> for ever<WH05769>.
Blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478> from everlasting<WH05769>, and to everlasting<WH05769>. Amen<WH0543>, and Amen<WH0543>.<CM>
